question: Jnanpith Award contains a cash prize along with a bronze replica of Goddess ______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (29/01/2021) Shift 1)

Saraswati
Durga
Sita
solution:

Explanation:

The cash prize currently stands at ₹11 lakh.

question: Who was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1922 for the work on the structure of atomic structure? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 2)

James Chadwick
Nils Bohr
J.J. Thomson
solution:

question: Which of the following is India's highest civilian award? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: Padmashri

Padma Vibhushan
Bharat Ratna
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bharat Ratna

Explanation:
Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India. It was instituted in 1954 and is awarded for exceptional contributions in the fields of art, literature, science, public service, and sports. Among the Padma awards, Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri are the second, third, and fourth highest civilian awards respectively.

question: Rabindranath Tagore got his Nobel Prize in literature for which work? (RPF Constable 2018 (24/01/2019) Shift 3)

Gitanjali
Amar Shonar Bangla
solution:

Explanation:
Rabindranath Tagore was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 for his collection of poems Gitanjali. The word 'Gitanjali' means 'offering of songs'. His other notable work 'Amar Shonar Bangla' is the national anthem of Bangladesh, while 'Jana Gana Mana', also composed by him, is the national anthem of India.

भारत रत्न भारत का सर्वोच्च नागरिक पुरस्कार है। सत्यजीत रे प्रसिद्ध फिल्म निर्माता, निर्देशक और लेखक थे। उन्हें 1992 में भारत रत्न से सम्मानित किया गया, जिससे वे यह पुरस्कार पाने वाले पहले फिल्म निर्माता बने। उनकी फिल्मों ने भारतीय सिनेमा को वैश्विक पहचान दिलाई। पृथ्वीराज कपूर, अशोक कुमार और दादा साहेब फाल्के भी महान फिल्म हस्तियां हैं, लेकिन भारत रत्न प्राप्त करने में सत्यजीत रे अग्रणी थे। यह पुरस्कार कला, साहित्य और समाज में असाधारण योगदान के लिए दिया जाता है।
